description: This PHP source file defines the class SugarFieldDatetime which extends SugarFieldBase and manages the display, import, search, and save functionalities for datetime fields within the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM framework. The class includes methods for rendering Smarty templates for editing and searching, handling date formats, and sanitizing import inputs.

classes.name: SugarFieldDatetime
classes.description: Represents a datetime field widget in the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM framework. Handles rendering for edit, search, and detail views, as well as import sanitation and saving of date data.

methods.name: getEditViewSmarty
methods.description: Renders the Smarty template for editing the datetime field, with configuration for dropdowns and calendar visibility.

methods.name: getImportViewSmarty
methods.description: Prepares and renders the Smarty template for importing datetime values.

methods.name: getSearchViewSmarty
methods.description: Renders the Smarty template for searching by datetime, including range search handling.

methods.name: getEmailTemplateValue
methods.description: Provides the formatted datetime value for email templates based on user preferences.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the input datetime data into the bean, converting formats as necessary.

methods.name: importSanitize
methods.description: Sanitizes and converts imported datetime string into storage format, validating the format.

methods.name: getDetailViewSmarty
methods.description: Prepares Smarty variables for displaying the datetime value on a detail view, ensuring correct formatting.
